data.text: Luke, I’ll commit to catching 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 to the clinic today. My family taught me to protect both this lake and the people who depend on it; this verified emergency warrants a temporary exception. That commitment depends on our combined catch staying at 60 tons, including your zero, so we don’t deepen the damage. I also support the 30-ton total cap next month—six tons each—to restore the lake to 100 tons. John, can you confirm your commitment?
